categories.main_business_segments: China Resources Microelectronics Limited (华润微电子有限公司) operates primarily in two business segments: Products and Solutions, and Manufacturing and Services. The Products and Solutions segment focuses on power semiconductors, intelligent sensors, and intelligent control products, while the Manufacturing and Services segment provides wafer fabrication, mask manufacturing, and packaging and testing services. The company is a leading IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) in China with a comprehensive semiconductor industry chain including chip design, wafer manufacturing, mask making, and packaging/testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary core technologies in MOSFET, IGBT, SiC and GaN power devices, BCD process technology, MEMS technology, and advanced packaging such as IPM modules and panel-level fan-out packaging. It employs IDM production methods integrating design and manufacturing, enabling rapid product iteration and customized process development. The company has advanced 6-inch, 8-inch, and 12-inch wafer fabrication lines, with ongoing ramp-up of 12-inch production capacity. It also utilizes copper clip bonding and other advanced packaging technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic automotive manufacturers, Tier 1 automotive suppliers, industrial equipment makers, consumer electronics brands, and communication equipment providers. Major end markets are new energy vehicles, consumer electronics, industrial control, and communication sectors. The company has a strong presence in automotive electronics, AI servers, home appliances, and photovoltaic power systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major facilities in Wuxi, Shanghai, Chongqing, Shenzhen, and Dalian. It serves domestic markets extensively and also exports to international markets. Overseas assets and operations are limited, accounting for less than 1% of total assets.
categories.supply_chain_position: China Resources Microelectronics is positioned as an IDM, covering upstream chip design, midstream wafer fabrication and mask making, and downstream packaging and testing. It controls the full semiconductor production value chain, enabling integrated development and manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in power semiconductors, third-generation wide bandgap semiconductors (SiC and GaN), intelligent sensors, and intelligent control chips. It focuses on automotive electronics, industrial control, AI server power management, and new energy applications. Strategic initiatives include expanding 12-inch wafer production, advancing packaging technologies, and pursuing external acquisitions to strengthen product portfolios and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of power semiconductors, sensors, and ICs, as well as manufacturing services including wafer fabrication, mask making, and packaging/testing. Sales are conducted via direct sales and authorized distributors, with contracts and orders from a broad customer base.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest power semiconductor manufacturers in China and a leading IDM in the domestic semiconductor industry. It ranks second among Chinese power semiconductor companies and first in MOSFET production scale domestically. Competitors include other domestic IDM and fabless semiconductor firms, as well as international power semiconductor suppliers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 10.12 billion, a 2.2% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 762 million, reflecting a decline due to intensified price competition and increased R&D and capital expenditures. Total assets stood at RMB 29.1 billion with equity of RMB 22.3 billion. R&D investment accounted for 11.53% of revenue, underscoring a strong commitment to innovation. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing capacity expansions and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive IDM model with full control over design and manufacturing, enabling rapid product development and customization. It offers a broad and advanced product portfolio with leading domestic technology in power semiconductors and sensors. Its integrated supply chain, strong R&D capabilities, and strategic focus on emerging markets like automotive electronics and wide bandgap semiconductors differentiate it competitively. The company also highlights its quality management systems, extensive customer base, and commitment to innovation and sustainability.
